name: Eagle F1 R Z29 Aero (tube type)

origin.basis: Goodyear's bicycle-tire line was developed with Rubber Kinetics by a team at Goodyear's Akron, Ohio headquarters (Bicycle Retailer, 2018).

manufacturing.basis: Goodyear does not state where these tires are made.

positioning: 29 mm aero race clincher from the Eagle F1 R family.
weight_basis: Goodyear store weights for the tube-type SKUs.

availability.note: Sold by Goodyear Bicycle Tires' US-dollar web store and by Tmall shops in mainland China; European availability not verified.

price_observations.conditions: Official store price on 2026-11-01; one tire; US shipping and tax at checkout.

caveats: The single store option does not state which construction it ships in.

image.shown: Exterior close-up of the Eagle F1 R Z29 Aero on a wheel; Goodyear shows this photo for the tube-type and tubeless versions, and the construction is not visible.
image.alt: Close-up of a Goodyear Eagle F1 R Z29 Aero road tire mounted on a deep carbon wheel

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-04 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Comments on one construction's test page count for that construction unless the owner names the other.

checks.note: Listed with no written review; the listing does not state the construction
